limitations: Deterministic ports and trusted-clock advances do not qualify a native coding workflow or model.
Checks occur on coordinator advancement; status projection alone does not expire an idle approval and no autonomous timer was added.
Blocking ports and persistence are not preempted; native manifest/load/token binding and aggregate preflight still require in-flight control on the existing live worker.
Canonical request construction time and exact current/legacy digests preserve recovery without renewed run time.
Late executed-tool receipts remain; exhaustion of an unstarted operation never fabricates a denial, cancellation, receipt or completed turn.
Actual CLI refusals prove preservation before admitted work, not coexistence during effects.
Native executable trust and user-systemd prerequisites remain unavailable; confinement was not bypassed.
Complete historical inputs and original tested revisions remain; no global, transitive or line-span freshness claim.
Source automation is separate from external review and cannot close human-only, platform, model or release gates.
